summary: Lionheart Holdings filed an 8-K reporting an extraordinary general meeting where shareholders approved an extension of the deadline to complete a business combination from June 20, 2026 to March 20, 2027. The extension was approved with 15,786,622 votes for and 1,468,989 against. In connection with the meeting, 4,503,836 public shares were redeemed at ~$10.88 per share, leaving $201.2M in trust. Additionally, the sponsor converted 3,000,000 Class B shares to Class A shares on a one-for-one basis. This is a routine SPAC extension and redemption process, not a special situation.
